**BlueMapSignPosts {{VERSION}}**, released {{DATE}}

Allows players to add [BlueMap](https://bluemap.bluecolored.de/) markers using signs and banners. It runs on Paper and Purpur {{MINECRAFT}} with BlueMap 5.24 or newer on the same server.

## Install

1. Download `BlueMapSignPosts-{{VERSION}}.jar` below.
2. Put it in your server's `plugins` folder next to BlueMap, replacing any older BlueMapSignPosts jar.
3. Restart the server.

Your markers and settings are kept when you upgrade. The `.sha256` file holds the jar's checksum. If something isn't working, see [troubleshooting](https://github.com/lewisgibson/bluemap-sign-posts/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.md).
